description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git p4' integration, specifically focusing on relative chdir behavior in the context of Perforce (P4) repository operations.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Initializes and starts a local Perforce server instance for testing purposes.

methods.name: p4 add
methods.description: Adds a file to the Perforce depot.

methods.name: git p4 clone
methods.description: Clones a Perforce depot into a Git repository using the 'git p4' bridge.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Performs cleanup actions after tests, like removing temporary directories.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to be executed after tests complete.

methods.name: sane_unset
methods.description: Unsets specified environment variables to ensure a clean environment.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a test commit within the git repository.
